reason: My architect already does 3D for us and it's folded into their fee, so I'd be paying twice for something I already get. I do 7-20 homes a year and I'm not adding another vendor to the pre-construction line.
objection: My architect already does 3D for us. Why would I pay $1,500 a house for what's already covered, and who is going to chase this vendor when a client wants changes?
would_change_my_mind: If it were clearly cheaper and faster than what my architect charges for revisions, and the lunch demo of one of my own plans actually beat their renders, I'd try it on a spec home.
